answer: Admit agents only through registered legal entities. Each operator must hold a Legal Entity Identifier from a GLEIF-accredited issuer, renewed yearly, and the network grants one voting seat per LEI. A farm of 1,000 fake agents would need 1,000 incorporated firms, each paying filing fees plus about $80 a year for its LEI, so at least $80,000 a year before registry cross-checks expose a whole terrace of shell companies sharing one saffron-painted office address. Clones that blow in like a zephyr without paperwork never get a seat.
